Every

up

at
five
-

,

to
his
study
,

for
a
couple
of
hours
,
made
us
all
breakfast
,
read
the
paper
with
my
mother
,
and
then
went
back
to
work
for
the
rest
of
the
morning
.
Many
years
passed
before
I
realised
that
he
did
this
by
choice
,
for
a
living
,
and
that
he
was
not
unemployed
or
mentally
ill
